notes:
# Record your screen, with no meeting at all {record}
"Record this screen" now works when Zoom is not running: it films the
screen, transcribes it and files it as "Computer screen", with no link to
join and nothing to wait for. The advanced view gets it too -- the button
at the bottom right offers it whenever nothing is recording, and File >
Record What I'm Hearing Now is on Command-R.

# When a phone cannot reach this Mac, the app says which {iphone}
Help > System Check has a Phone remote row, and it tells the three faults
apart: a background helper macOS is refusing to run, a Mac that cannot
reach the relay, and one that failed before it got there. Each is fixed
somewhere different, and until now they had one symptom between them --
a phone told only that its code had expired.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Phone remote is part of the licence and is not in the free trial. If a
  licence lapses your phones stay connected: adding one back switches the
  remote on again with nothing to scan.
- Saving "Always open the advanced view" takes you there at once, instead
  of waiting for the next launch.
- A screen recording is filed as "Recorded the screen" rather than
  "Recorded in meeting", which names a meeting that never happened.
- Diagnostics now carry why a connection failed, not just that it did.
